scope: Bundled orbital maps for Earth, Mars, Venus and Jupiter. Procedural flight terrain is original and does not reproduce measured topography.
reuse_summary: NASA 3D hub says its assets are free to download/use subject to NASA media guidelines. NASA media guidelines generally permit factual and computer graphical simulation uses with source acknowledgement; protected NASA identifiers, marked third-party copyright and implied endorsement are excluded. JPL policy permits image use subject to credit, no endorsement and its stated special cases. No NASA/JPL logos or people are included.

recommended_assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Blue Marble data courtesy of Reto Stockli (NASA/GSFC) and NASA Earth Observatory
recommended_assets.notes: Inspected: land/ocean/ice map without baked clouds. Original 2048x1024. Add cloud shell separately.

recommended_assets.projection: Planetocentric latitude-longitude cylindrical, full 360 degrees longitude and 180 degrees latitude
recommended_assets.notes: Inspected: grid-free Cassini December 2000 colour mosaic; includes Great Red Spot and faint polar haze. 3601x1801 original. Parent may resize for 2K runtime budget. No third-party copyright restriction identified in caption; retain full stated credit.

runtime_variant.derivation: Original preserved separately. Proportional downsample only using sips -Z 2048; no painting, recolouring or generated detail.

recommended_assets.credit: NASA/Jet Propulsion Laboratory & Caltech; Viking imagery processed at USGS
recommended_assets.notes: Inspected: 1440x720 colour surface map with caps, Valles Marineris, volcanoes and craters. NASA 3D source.

recommended_assets.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech; Magellan radar imagery, JPL/Caltech planetary map database
recommended_assets.credit_note: Source page states Magellan/JPL-Caltech database but no separately labelled credit line.
recommended_assets.projection: Full-world 2:1 surface texture for sphere models
recommended_assets.notes: Inspected: 1440x720 orange colourized RADAR terrain with filled gaps. NOT natural-colour cloud tops; opaque pale cloud cover should dominate orbital Venus if aiming for an optical view.

inspection: Every image was opened visually after verifying actual pixel dimensions. Mercury is explicitly conditional because none of the inspected originals are a clean seamless 2K map.
integration_decision: Use Earth, Jupiter, Mars and Venus. Skip Mercury candidates because of visible gaps/seams/UV atlas; retain existing procedural Mercury globe.
